literal_meaning: পুরানো বা জীর্ণ (old or worn out)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বুরা না মানো, আমি শুধু মজা করছি।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't take it badly, I'm just joking.
If it feels bad, let me know.
note: This expression is often used in spoken Bengali to soften potentially offensive remarks, rooted in colloquial usage.
